# Agent Radar

> Agent Radar is a directory of 54 AI tools (coding agents, app builders, databases and backends, hosting and deployment, agent frameworks, LLM APIs, automation, focus and planning) with pricing summaries and free-tier information taken from each tool's official site, plus a Prompt Vault of 31 original copy-ready prompts. Data last checked 2026-11-09. Pricing changes often; confirm on the official pricing page.

## Main pages
- [Tools directory](https://www.tryagentradar.com/): all 54 tools
- [Prompt Vault](https://www.tryagentradar.com/vault.html): 31 prompts
- [Advertise](https://www.tryagentradar.com/advertise.html): featured listings (labeled "Sponsored")
- [Disclosure](https://www.tryagentradar.com/disclosure.html): affiliate links and sponsored listings policy
- [Terms of Use](https://www.tryagentradar.com/terms.html), [Privacy](https://www.tryagentradar.com/privacy.html), [Refunds](https://www.tryagentradar.com/refunds.html), [Disclaimer](https://www.tryagentradar.com/disclaimer.html)
- [tools.json](https://www.tryagentradar.com/data/tools.json): raw tool data
- [Sitemap](https://www.tryagentradar.com/sitemap.xml)

## ADHD section
- [AI tools that help with focus, by struggle](https://www.tryagentradar.com/adhd/): 13 planning, focus, capture, reminder and email tools for people with ADHD, organized by struggle. Not medical advice; the tools don't treat ADHD.
- [How a Grok Bot assistant can help with ADHD](https://www.tryagentradar.com/adhd/grok-bot.html): setup recipes for morning reminders, brain dumps, weekly reviews, appointment prep and check-ins.
- Planning & time blindness (https://www.tryagentradar.com/adhd/#planning): Sunsama, Motion, Akiflow, Reclaim.ai, Tiimo, Structured
- Getting started on tasks (https://www.tryagentradar.com/adhd/#start): Focusmate, Goblin Tools, Tiimo, ChatGPT
- Focus sessions (https://www.tryagentradar.com/adhd/#focus): Focusmate, Brain.fm
- Capturing thoughts (brain dump) (https://www.tryagentradar.com/adhd/#capture): Akiflow, Saner.AI, Todoist, Notion, ChatGPT
- Reminders & routines (https://www.tryagentradar.com/adhd/#reminders): Reclaim.ai, Todoist, Tiimo, Structured
- Email & admin (https://www.tryagentradar.com/adhd/#admin): Akiflow, Saner.AI, Goblin Tools

## Comparisons and guides
- [Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex](https://www.tryagentradar.com/compare/claude-code-vs-codex.html): Claude Code vs OpenAI Codex compared: plan prices and free access as of Oct 2026, best use cases, strengths, drawbacks and FAQs.
- [Cursor vs Claude Code vs Codex](https://www.tryagentradar.com/compare/cursor-vs-claude-code-vs-codex.html): Cursor, Claude Code and OpenAI Codex compared side by side: plan prices and free access as of Oct 2026, best for, strengths, drawbacks and FAQs.
- [n8n vs Make vs Zapier](https://www.tryagentradar.com/compare/n8n-vs-make-vs-zapier.html): n8n, Make and Zapier compared: free plans, starting prices and billing units as of Oct 2026, plus best for, strengths, drawbacks and FAQs.
- [Lovable vs Base44 vs Replit](https://www.tryagentradar.com/compare/lovable-vs-base44-vs-replit.html): Lovable, Base44 and Replit compared as AI app builders: free plans and prices as of Oct 2026, best for, strengths, drawbacks and FAQs.
- [Best vector database for RAG](https://www.tryagentradar.com/best/vector-database-for-rag.html): Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate and Chroma compared for RAG: free tiers, starting prices and limits as of Oct 2026, plus which to pick and FAQs.
- [Railway vs Vercel vs Render](https://www.tryagentradar.com/compare/railway-vs-vercel-vs-render.html): Railway, Vercel and Render compared for hosting apps and databases: free plans, plan fees and usage billing as of Nov 2026, plus best for, strengths, drawbacks and FAQs.
- [Best Cursor alternatives](https://www.tryagentradar.com/best/cursor-alternatives.html): Cursor alternatives compared after Cursor's October 2026 move to The X Subscription: Windsurf, Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot and Cline, with prices as of Nov 2026.
- [Best vibe coding tools](https://www.tryagentradar.com/best/vibe-coding-tools.html): The best vibe coding tools for building apps from a prompt: Lovable, Bolt, v0, Replit and Emergent compared, with free plans and prices as of Nov 2026.
- [Lovable vs Bolt](https://www.tryagentradar.com/compare/lovable-vs-bolt.html): Lovable vs Bolt compared as AI app builders: free plans, paid plans and how usage is metered as of Nov 2026, plus best for, strengths, drawbacks and FAQs.
- [Supabase vs Firebase vs Convex](https://www.tryagentradar.com/compare/supabase-vs-firebase-vs-convex.html): Supabase, Firebase and Convex compared as app backends: free tiers, paid plans and data models as of Nov 2026, plus best for, strengths, drawbacks and FAQs.

## Tools
- [Cursor](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/cursor.html): AI coding environment with an agent for building software, plus cloud agents on Premium and above. Since October 2026 it is sold as part of The X Subscription. Free tier available.
- [Claude Code](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/claude-code.html): Anthropic's coding agent, included with Claude paid plans. No free tier found.
- [OpenAI Codex](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/codex.html): OpenAI's coding agent available in the CLI, IDE extension, web and desktop app. Free tier available.
- [GitHub Copilot](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/github-copilot.html): GitHub's AI coding assistant for editors, the CLI and GitHub itself. Free tier available.
- [Cline](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/cline.html): Open-source autonomous coding agent that runs in your editor and works with your own model API keys. Free tier available.
- [Aider](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/aider.html): Open-source AI pair-programming tool that runs in your terminal and integrates with git. Free tier available.
- [Windsurf](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/windsurf.html): AI coding tool with agents and tab completions, available as an editor and CLI. Free tier available.
- [OpenCode](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/opencode.html): Open-source coding agent (MIT-licensed, GitHub: anomalyco/opencode) that runs as a terminal UI, desktop app or IDE extension and works with many model providers. Free tier available.
- [Google Antigravity](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/antigravity.html): Google's agentic development platform: an AI IDE plus a desktop app, CLI and SDK for running coding agents. Free tier available.
- [Lovable](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/lovable.html): AI software engineer that builds websites and web apps from chat prompts. Free tier available.
- [Bolt](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/bolt.html): Prompt-to-app builder for creating and deploying web apps in the browser. Free tier available.
- [v0](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/v0.html): Vercel's AI app and UI builder that deploys to Vercel and syncs with GitHub. Free tier available.
- [Replit](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/replit.html): Browser-based platform where Replit Agent builds, hosts and deploys apps from prompts. Free tier available.
- [Base44](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/base44.html): Prompt-to-app builder that generates apps with a built-in backend, database and user auth, with GitHub sync on higher plans. Free tier available.
- [Emergent](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/emergent.html): Vibe-coding platform that builds web and mobile apps from a chat description, with built-in hosting. Free tier available.
- [Supabase](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/supabase.html): Open-source-based Postgres backend platform with auth, storage and APIs. Free tier available.
- [Neon](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/neon.html): Serverless Postgres with branching and usage-based pricing. Free tier available.
- [Turso](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/turso.html): SQLite-compatible cloud database platform built for many lightweight databases. Free tier available.
- [PlanetScale](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/planetscale.html): Managed MySQL (Vitess) and Postgres databases. No free tier found.
- [Pinecone](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/pinecone.html): Hosted vector store queried over an API, for teams that would rather not run servers; costs scale with usage. Free tier available.
- [Qdrant](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/qdrant.html): Open-source vector search engine with a managed cloud. Free tier available.
- [Weaviate](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/weaviate.html): Vector database with managed cloud clusters. Free tier available.
- [Chroma](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/chroma.html): Open-source embedding store you can self-host or use as a paid cloud; in our view best for prototypes, as scaling it yourself takes work. Free tier available.
- [Firebase](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/firebase.html): Google's app development platform with databases, auth, hosting and functions. Free tier available.
- [Convex](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/convex.html): Reactive backend platform where database queries, mutations and server functions are written in TypeScript, with file storage, search, crons and auth built in. Free tier available.
- [Vercel](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/vercel.html): Cloud platform for deploying frontends and serverless backends from Git, with a global CDN, functions, preview deployments and AI tooling. Free tier available.
- [Railway](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/railway.html): Usage-billed platform for hosting apps, background workers and databases, metered per second for CPU, memory and disk. Free tier available.
- [Render](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/render.html): Cloud platform for web services, workers, cron jobs, static sites and managed Postgres and Redis-compatible Key Value, deployed from Git. Free tier available.
- [LangChain](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/langchain.html): Framework (MIT-licensed on GitHub) for building agents and LLM apps, with LangSmith for observability. Free tier available.
- [LlamaIndex](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/llamaindex.html): Data framework (MIT-licensed on GitHub) and LlamaCloud for document parsing and retrieval for LLM apps. Free tier available.
- [CrewAI](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/crewai.html): Framework (MIT-licensed on GitHub) and platform for building multi-agent workflows. Free tier available.
- [AutoGen](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/autogen.html): Microsoft-backed Python library for coordinating LLM agents that hand tasks to each other; in our view setup is heavier than simpler options. Free tier available.
- [OpenAI API](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/openai-api.html): OpenAI's developer API for GPT models, embeddings, audio and image generation. Free tier unverified.
- [Anthropic API (Claude Platform)](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/anthropic-api.html): Anthropic's developer platform for building with Claude models. Free tier unverified.
- [Google Gemini API](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/gemini-api.html): Google's Gemini Developer API for building with Gemini models. Free tier available.
- [Groq](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/groq.html): AI inference cloud built on Groq's LPU hardware. Free tier unverified.
- [OpenRouter](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/openrouter.html): Unified API for accessing many LLM providers and models. Free tier available.
- [Ollama](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/ollama.html): Tool for running open models locally, with optional cloud models. Free tier available.
- [n8n](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/n8n.html): Workflow automation platform with AI capabilities, hosted or self-hosted. Free tier unverified.
- [Zapier](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/zapier.html): No-code automation connecting thousands of apps, with AI features. Free tier available.
- [Make](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/make.html): Visual automation platform for building scenarios across apps. Free tier available.
- [Sunsama](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/sunsama.html): Daily planner that pulls tasks from your other work tools into one plan for the day, which you then time-block on your calendar. No free tier found.
- [Motion](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/motion.html): AI calendar and project manager that places your tasks into open time on your calendar and reshuffles them when plans change. No free tier found.
- [Akiflow](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/akiflow.html): Task and calendar app that collects tasks from email and other apps into one inbox, with quick capture, time blocking and a daily planning routine. No free tier found.
- [Reclaim.ai](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/reclaim.html): AI calendar assistant for Google and Outlook Calendar that automatically protects focus time, habits and breaks around your meetings. Free tier available.
- [Saner.AI](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/saner-ai.html): AI assistant that brings notes, tasks, email and calendar into one place and suggests what to work on next. Free tier available.
- [Todoist](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/todoist.html): To-do list app with natural-language Quick Add, reminders, and Ramble, a voice feature that turns what you say into separate tasks with dates. Free tier available.
- [Focusmate](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/focusmate.html): Virtual coworking: you book a short video session with another person, each say your goal, and work side by side (often called body doubling). Free tier available.
- [Goblin Tools](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/goblin-tools.html): Collection of small single-task AI tools made mostly for neurodivergent people. Magic ToDo breaks a task into smaller steps; other tools help with tone, time estimates and more. Free tier available.
- [Tiimo](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/tiimo.html): Visual daily planner designed for neurodivergent people, with a timeline of your day, a focus timer, to-dos and AI help splitting tasks into subtasks. Free tier available.
- [Structured](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/structured.html): Day planner that shows your tasks and calendar events together on a single visual timeline. Free tier available.
- [Brain.fm](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/brain-fm.html): Music app with tracks made for focus, relaxation and sleep, sorted by activity such as deep work, light work or learning. No free tier found.
- [Notion](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/notion.html): Workspace for notes, documents and databases, with Notion AI and Notion Agent for chat, drafting and autofill. Free tier available.
- [ChatGPT](https://www.tryagentradar.com/tools/chatgpt.html): OpenAI's AI assistant, with voice chat on web and mobile that you can use to talk through a brain dump and get it back as a list. Free tier available.
